names.categoryDhatDescription: Attributes of the Divine Essence — necessarily and eternally true of Allah independent of creation
names.categorySifatDescription: Attributes of Meaning — the seven positive qualities (Knowledge, Power, Will, Life, Hearing, Sight, Speech) and names expressing tanzih (transcendence)
names.categoryAfalDescription: Attributes of Act — names that express Allah's sovereign relation to creation: creating, providing, guiding, forgiving
